svg.aria-label: DevOps lifecycle: Plan, Code, Build, Test, Secure, Release, Deploy, Operate, Monitor — a continuous loop
svg.text: // how i ship — every change goes round this loop

g.text: Agree what to build, track the work
Package the app into a container
Scan code, images and infra for risks
Run, scale and patch in the cloud
Watch health, alert, feed back into planning
